item.title: Rain likely to start out the week with high elevation mountain snow
item.description: Happy Sunday, Utah! We'll see slight chances of rain showers for our afternoon with temperatures still running 10-15° above average throughout most of the state.

item.title: Girl killed in Brighton avalanche was buried under 4 feet of snow for 17 minutes, report says
item.description: The Utah Avalanche Center has released a report detailing the circumstances of an avalanche that resulted in the death of an 11-year-old girl just outside the boundary at Brighton Resort late February.

item.title: Salt Lake City records warmest winter to date, averaging over 40 degrees
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY (ABC4) -- The 2025-2026 winter season will go down as Salt Lake City's warmest winter on record, dating back over 150 years, according to the National Weather Service (NWS).

item.title: US, Israel pound targets in Iran as Trump signals openness to talk to new leadership
item.description: Trump said in an interview Sunday that he planned to speak with Iran’s new leadership.

item.title: One dead, one injured after being ejected from vehicle on I-15 on-ramp
item.description: One person is dead after a rollover crash on an I-15 on ramp. According to the Utah Department of Transportation, the crash occurred at approximately 4:30 p.m. on northbound I-15 on the 3300 south on-ramp.

item.title: Millcreek anime shop robbed of over $4,000 of rare collectibles, police looking for suspect
item.description: Unified Police are searching for a man who robbed a local anime shop of thousands of dollars' worth of rare collectibles on Friday.

item.title: 'What other choice do we have?': Iranians of Utah speak on U.S., Israel attack on Iran
item.description: Members of Iranians of Utah are speaking out after the United States and Israel launched an attack on Iran, killing its Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Record-Shattering Winter Review
item.description: Meteorological Winter runs from the 1st of December through the last day of February (as opposed to Astronomical Winter which ends on the 20th of March). This Winter was extremely warm and as a result, our snowfall was not just record-breaking, it was downright pitiful. So let's dive into the numbers to see how this Winter stacks up.

item.title: Man arrested after allegedly biting store employee and attempting to flee with merchandise stuffed in pants
item.description: A man was arrested after allegedly attempting to leave a WINCO grocery store with merchandise stuffed into his pants and biting one of the store's loss prevention officers.
